basics.name: Punit Yadav
basics.label: Product Manager — Consumer Marketplace, Booking Flows & Growth
basics.summary: Product Manager with 7 years of experience building consumer booking and marketplace products, 5 of them at MediBuddy where I own the demand side of a INR 150 Cr surgery business running ~1,500 procedures and ~INR 11 Cr per month. Five PRDs authored and shipped to development, four systems built from zero. I write SQL, instrument my own events, and ship working prototypes when that is the fastest way to learn whether an idea deserves a sprint.

highlights: Authored 5 PRDs shipped to development and contributed the CRM integration specification to a sixth.
Grew funnel entries from 90,000 to 150,000 per month, a 1.4x lead increase at flat acquisition cost.

Built and shipped an automated consult booking service producing ~10 bookings/day with no human involvement and 60-70 surgeries/month, equivalent to 5-6 agents of capacity.
Owned the customer side of a full CRM replacement across ~350 seats, retiring two systems with zero downtime on an operation carrying ~5,000 outbound calls/day.
Removed a 7 person-day rule-engine build from scope by reducing real-time evaluation to a single eligibility check.
Increased condition-page conversion from 1.2% to 1.4% via a no-code CMS, adding ~1,200 leads/month.
Recovered dental payment drop-offs for a 5% revenue uplift on the dental line.
Opened cross-vertical lead capture from lab tests, medicine orders and offline OPD consultations.
Sustained CSAT above 60 and NPS above 7 through Typeform and CRM feedback capture.

Owned the data and reconciliation layer of a 1,340-camp national vaccination programme covering 249,000 doses and INR 27.9 Cr of billing; resolved 7,666 doses of variance, protecting ~INR 72 lakh in billing accuracy.
